conventions.convention: Inner products are linear in the first variable; the quotient pairing is ⟨[a],[b]⟩ρ = ρ(b*a).
Matrix size is an integer n ≥ 1; involution is conjugate transpose and the operator norm is the supremum on the Euclidean unit ball.
A state is a bounded positive linear functional of norm one; positivity means ρ(a*a) ≥ 0 for every a.
The trace Hilbert-space pairing is Tr(c*b)/n. Reducibility means having a nonzero proper closed invariant subspace; the trace conclusions distinguish n = 1 from n ≥ 2.

load_bearing.statement: For n ≥ 1, M_n(C) = B(C^n), with the stated Euclidean inner product, conjugate-transpose involution and operator norm, is a unital complex C*-algebra.

Each coordinate vector functional ω_j is a state whose quotient GNS model is the defining representation. Normalized trace has the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt left-multiplication model; for n ≥ 2 it is non-extreme and its representation is reducible. For n = 1, τ = ω_1 and the representation is irreducible.
